boxes.title: Saluva rule (1485-91)
head: Angle
Fact
rows: Weak kings after **Devaraya II**; **Virupaksha II** a drunkard (Nuniz); Gajapati + Bahmani raids
General **Tuluva Narasa Nayaka**; Saluva styled ==**Raya Maharasu**==
Took **Honnavar, Bhatkal, Mangalore**; lost **Udayagiri** to Gajapati **Purushottama**

boxes.title: Tuluva origin
items: Name from **Tulunadu** (Mysore region), conquered by **Harihara** in **1342**
Progenitor **Timmaraju**; mother tongue **Kannada**, Telugu favoured
**Tuluva Narasa Nayaka**: real ruler under Immadi Narasimha; died **1503**
Immadi killed at **Penugonda**; ⚠ Narasa Nayaka aided both usurpations, but ==founder = Vira Narasimha==
Line: Vira Narasimha (**1505-09**) → Krishnadevaraya → Achyutaraya (**1529-42**) → **Venkata I** (**1542**) → Sadasiva (**1543-70/76**)

boxes.title: Campaigns: added detail
items: Kovilkonda = **Diwani**: Bahmani "jihad" crushed
Raichur Doab: freed Sultan **Mahmud Shah** from **Ali Barid**
Ummattur / **Sivasamudram**: **Gangaraja** defeated
Kalinga drive **1513-1519**: win back Tirandhra + Telangana from Prataparudra
Kondaveedu: Timmarusu split **Veerabhadra** Gajapati's army; ==**Talapurusha Danam** at **Amaravati**==
Kondapalli, **Bejawada**: **Praharajeshwara** beaten; Telangana forts **Devarakonda, Nalgonda, Kambhamettu, Jallipalli, Warangal**
Gajapati bride: **Annapurnadevi** ⚠ other notes: **Bhadradevi** (Tukka / Jaganmohini); lands north of Krishna returned

cards.title: Meaning
lines: "One who offers the garland she has worn"

cards.title: Status
lines: ==First Telugu work named after its heroine==

boxes.title: Other works & poets
items: More Sanskrit: **Jnana Chintamani**, **Satyavadhu Parinayam**, **Sakala Katha Sara Sangrahamu**; some notes add **Usha Parinayam**
Jambavati Kalyanam mentions **Virupaksha** + Vasantotsavams
Tippalur inscription calls them ==**Kavula Samstha**==; agrahara in **Kadapa**
Peddana: **Swarochisha Manu Sambhavam**; king fixed **Gandapenderam** anklet on his foot
Pingali Surana: **Kalapurnodayamu**; Ramarajabhushana (**Bhattumurti**): **Narasabhupaliyamu**, Vasucharitra to **Tirumala Raya**
⚠ "Prabandha Parameshwara" = **Errana**, not Nandi Timmana; **Radhamadhava Kavi**: Chintalapudi Ellanarya

boxes.title: Titles, Portuguese, visitors
head: Item
Fact
rows: **Kannada Rajya Rama Ramana**, Gajapati Gajakuta Pakaveni, Dakshinapatha Swami, **Mururaya Raganda**, Paribhuta Suratrana
Defeated **Martin de Souza** (temples); **Joao de Castro** made peace
Palace, festivals, army, markets; =="House of Victory"==

boxes.title: After Krishnadevaraya
items: Achyutaraya also crowned at **Srikalahasti**; ==only king crowned at Tirumala==; power with **Salakam** brothers
**Aliya Rama Raya**: son-in-law, **Aravidu** family; killed **Salakam Tirumala** (**1543**)
His **divide and rule** united the Sultanates
Talikota = **Rakshasi-Tangadi / Bannihatti**; beheaded by **Hussain Nizam Shah** (some notes); **Tirumala** fled too
Sadasivakona: ==**trilingual**== (Telugu, Tamil, Kannada), **Seshachalam** forest; **Kaanika** taxes of **Gudimallam** lands
**Mangalagiri** temple renovation (**₹6 crore**): **Sri Krishna Devaraya Mandapam**
